summary: PrfEmailMessages implements a user control for managing staff email messages within a web application. It supports displaying, adding, editing, and deleting staff messages, with roles for session management, validation, and UI behaviors such as popups and grids.
purpose: To enable users (likely staff managers or administrators) to view, add, edit, and delete email messages attached to staff profiles, using a grid and form-based interface, with support for session-based access and editable screens.

workflows.name: Display Messages
steps: Grid loads staff messages based on StaffID and UserSession.
If no data exists and screen is editable, show 'add' button.

workflows.name: Add Message
steps: Input values are captured, including TypeCodeID.
Insert operation validates page, cancels if invalid.
Session is cached, page is redirected after success.

workflows.name: Edit Message
steps: User clicks edit button on grid row.
Update operation validates page; cancels if invalid.
Session is cached, page is redirected after success.

workflows.name: Delete Message
steps: Deletes staff message using session and ID.
Page is redirected to current page.

business_rules: Grid buttons for add, edit, delete are enabled/disabled based on ScreenIsEditable.
No data template only visible if no rows exist and screen is editable.
Staff message delete and update/insert operations depend on valid session and StaffID.
validations: Page.IsValid is checked on insert and update; operation is cancelled if invalid.
Form values (TypeCodeID) are obtained from dropdown controls.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable: determines if add/edit/delete functions are enabled.
UserSession: must be present, otherwise selection/query is cancelled.
Grid row count: if zero and editable, show empty data panel.
system_behavior: UI updates and redirection after operations.
Modal popups are used for detail forms.
dependencies: Grid and FormView controls are dependent on session and StaffID parameters.
ObjectDataSource is used for data interaction.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection and operations are cancelled.
If Page validation fails, insert/update is cancelled.
content_gaps: Business logic details for StaffMessages backend methods are not described.
Error handling and user feedback strategies beyond redirection are not detailed.
Field validation specifics (range/format for TypeCodeID etc.) are not provided.
